alerts.subject: [C6-MED] [News] PSMC Q3 Gross Margin Hits 48% on Memory Price Gains; Eyes 10–20% Mature-Node Price Hikes in 2027 - TrendForce
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22DRAM%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 04:02:07 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 [News] PSMC Q3 Gross Margin Hits 48% on Memory Price Gains; Eyes 10–20% Mature-Node Price Hikes in 2027 - TrendForce [News] PSMC Q3 Gross Margin Hits 48% on Memory Price Gains; Eyes 10–20% Mature-Node Price Hikes in 2027  TrendForce ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: Taiwan foundry PSMC reported Q3 gross margin of 48%, which it attributed to higher memory prices, and said it plans to raise mature-node wafer prices by 10-20% in 2027. The same headline arrived twice, likely from two feeds. 内容: 台湾晶圆厂 PSMC（力积电）Q3 毛利率达到 48%，公司说主要靠存储涨价，并计划 2027 年把成熟制程报价上调 10-20%。同一条标题出现了两次，可能来自两个 feed。 Why it matters: Rising memory prices mean supply is tight, not in oversupply. This fits the view that HBM demand for AI is taking capacity away from commodity DRAM. It is not a bust signal, but it adds to AI build-out costs, and a shortage like this tends to cause double-ordering that ends in a sharp glut later. 影响: 存储涨价说明供给偏紧，不是过剩。这符合 AI 对 HBM 的需求在挤占普通 DRAM 产能的判断。它本身不是泡沫破裂信号，但会推高 AI 建设成本。这种缺货还容易引发重复下单，日后可能突然转成过剩。

alerts.subject: [C6-MED] AI-Driven Memory Price Surge Seen Reversing to 20-30% Decline by 2028 - BigGo Finance
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22DRAM%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 06:25:00 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTFBZd3U0a2hrN3hQMUU5U3hJVl9KcER5aVdRMGhyVFJZa3VuWDB5WTYwM1hyclJ0bFlJYU1LWGdIN0N2U191MFVHTEctdlhWN1VjX0VoVnZ4dTkwODhkTDNNaWxCSUplbkw5d21HTWFGVGlnb1paMlE?oc=5 AI-Driven Memory Price Surge Seen Reversing to 20-30% Decline by 2028 - BigGo Finance AI-Driven Memory Price Surge Seen Reversing to 20-30% Decline by 2028  BigGo Finance ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A news headline reports a forecast that the AI-driven surge in memory prices will reverse into a 20-30% price decline by 2028. This is a projection, not a current price move or an order cancellation. 内容: 一条新闻标题称，有预测认为由 AI 推动的内存涨价将在 2028 年前反转，价格下跌 20-30%。这是预测，不是当前的价格变动，也不是砍单。 Why it matters: Memory prices fall that hard when supply outruns demand. A 20-30% drop would mean today's HBM/DRAM capacity build-out has overshot real AI demand. It is a 2028 forecast, not a current stress signal, so it fits C6's oversupply tier as a forward warning rather than a live trigger. 影响: 内存价格跌这么多，说明供给跑赢了需求。如果真跌 20-30%，就说明眼下 HBM/DRAM 扩产已经超过了 AI 的真实需求。但这是对 2028 年的预测，不是此刻的压力信号，在 C6 里应当作供过于求的前瞻提示看，不算已经触发。

alerts.subject: [C6-MED] NAND flash shortage is quietly doubling SSD and laptop prices - Startup Fortune
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22HBM%22+OR+%22memory+chip%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 20:24:42 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxOMDdia2hjbFNXMERaRFBDSFFyNXM3X2hZUE0taTdLLVhnT0RZbmlaV1IzQnlzRktnZzBxaGZBbG1raHh2RzlZUnE1TjJtdWg1MkFyQXF3emQ2ODd3amgyWFdQVlI3YllwbERtaU5IWVB1MTdlWG1CbUxFcFphcERXNUxQMEw5M2xMQm1sS2o0Z0VWOXM?oc=5 NAND flash shortage is quietly doubling SSD and laptop prices - Startup Fortune NAND flash shortage is quietly doubling SSD and laptop prices  Startup Fortune ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A headline reports that a NAND flash shortage is pushing SSD and laptop prices up, in some cases doubling them. 内容: 一则新闻称 NAND flash 缺货正在推高 SSD 和笔记本电脑价格，部分产品价格翻倍。 Why it matters: A shortage driving prices up means demand is outrunning supply, the opposite of the oversupply and order-cancellation stress C6 watches for. It suggests AI data-center buildout is soaking up flash capacity and crowding out consumer supply, which supports the AI-capex demand story for now. It is also the setup for a later bust: memory is highly cyclical, and price spikes driven by shortage tend to bring capacity overbuild and then sharp oversupply. 影响: 缺货带动涨价，说明需求跑在供给前面。这和 C6 盯的供过于求、砍单正好相反。背后很可能是 AI 数据中心建设吃掉了 flash 产能，把消费端的供给挤掉了，眼下这是在支持 AI capex 的需求逻辑。但这也在给下一轮崩盘铺路：存储行业周期性很强，缺货引起的涨价通常会招来过度扩产，接着就是供给严重过剩。

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The US 10-year real (TIPS) yield hit 2.80% on 2026-10-19. That is 0.66pp above its trailing-90-day low of 2.14%, and up from 2.74% on 2026-10-16 [src: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DFII10].

内容:
美国 10 年期实际利率（TIPS）在 2026-10-19 升到 2.80%，比近 90 天低点 2.14% 高出 0.66pp，10-16 时还是 2.74% [src: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DFII10]。

Why it matters:
Real yields are the discount rate for long-duration assets. A 66bp rise in about three months cuts the present value of AI-capex payoffs that sit years out, and makes debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive. Fast real-yield spikes have historically come before de-ratings in high-multiple tech, so the AI trade's liquidity tailwind is tightening.

影响:
实际利率是长久期资产的折现率。三个月左右涨了 66bp，好几年后才回本的 AI capex 现值被压低，靠借债建数据中心的成本也跟着上去。过去实际利率急升往往走在高估值科技股杀估值之前，AI 交易背后的流动性顺风在收紧。

What this means:
The Nominal Broad US Dollar Index rose to 121.405 on 2026-10-16, up 2.987 points (about 2.5%) from its trailing-90-day low of 117.883.

内容:
Nominal Broad US Dollar Index 在 2026-10-16 升至 121.405，比近 90 天低点 117.883 高出 2.987 点，涨幅约 2.5%。

Why it matters:
A fast dollar rally tightens global financial conditions. It squeezes offshore dollar borrowers and the overseas revenue of US hyperscalers, which leaves less liquidity for long-duration bets like AI capex. It hits harder with the 10y real yield already at 2.78% (FRED DFII10, 2026-10-15), because both raise the cost of the capital that funds the build-out.

影响:
美元短期急涨会收紧全球金融条件。海外美元借款人压力变大，美国超大规模厂商的海外收入也会缩水，流向 AI capex 这类长久期押注的流动性随之变少。10 年期实际利率已在 2.78%（FRED DFII10，2026-10-15），两者叠加，AI 建设的融资成本会更高。

美国 10 年期实际收益率（TIPS）在 2026-10-16 升至 2.74%，比近 90 天低点 2.14% 高出 0.60 个百分点。

Higher real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex payoffs. They also make debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive to finance. A 60 bp jump in about three months tightens liquidity on exactly the high-multiple, cash-burning names the bubble thesis depends on.

实际收益率上行，远期 AI capex 回报的折现率随之抬高。靠举债建数据中心的融资成本也跟着变贵。三个月内涨 60 个基点，收紧的正是高估值、烧现金的那批公司的流动性，而泡沫逻辑最依赖的就是它们。

What this means:
The 10-year US real (TIPS) yield read 2.78% on 2026-10-15. That is above C10's 2.5% stress level, up from 2.84% on 10-14.

内容:
2026-10-15 美国 10 年期实际利率（TIPS）为 2.78%，高于 C10 设定的 2.5% 压力线。10-14 为 2.84%。

Why it matters:
A real yield near 2.8% raises the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex payoffs and makes debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive. Liquidity this tight compresses the multiples the AI trade depends on, even without a credit event. The 2.84% → 2.78% dip is noise; the level is the signal.

影响:
实际利率在 2.8% 左右，抬高了 AI capex 远期回报的折现率，靠举债建数据中心也更贵。流动性这么紧，就算没有信用事件，AI 交易依赖的估值倍数也会被压缩。2.84% 到 2.78% 的小幅回落是噪音，要看的是绝对水平。

The US 10-year real (TIPS) yield printed 2.84% on 2026-10-14, above the 2.5% stress level C10 watches.

美国 10 年期实际收益率（TIPS）在 2026-10-14 报 2.84%，高于 C10 设定的 2.5% 压力线。

Real yields this high raise the discount rate on long-duration growth equity and make debt-funded AI capex more expensive to carry. Sustained readings above 2.5% squeeze the valuation multiples and financing terms the AI-infrastructure buildout relies on, even with no change in fundamentals.

实际利率这么高，长久期成长股的估值折现率被抬高，靠举债推进的 AI capex 资金成本也更重。只要持续站在 2.5% 以上，AI 基建赖以支撑的估值倍数和融资条件就会被挤压，哪怕基本面一点没变。
